summary: LIVE UI verification of ChatGPT (OpenAI) integration as 3rd AI provider in DocuAnalytics AI. All critical flows verified via Playwright on the public preview URL: 4 model buttons render correctly, selecting ChatGPT updates hint, invoice upload + analysis via ChatGPT returns green 'ChatGPT' badge (class mb-openai) with correct extracted fields (Totale 1.220,00 EUR, imponibile 1.000,00, IVA 220,00, Numero 2026/114, ACME SRL, Studio Rossi, P.IVA, etc.), credits decrement by 1, and Copilot answers 'Il totale da pagare è 1.220,00 EUR.' using same model. ChatGPT mini variant also verified end-to-end (badge 'ChatGPT mini', class mb-openai, credits -1, total extracted). Gemini regression auto-run had a test-script timing issue (file-input not re-populated after returning to upload view) — not an app bug; Gemini/Claude were previously verified green by backend regression as noted in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: Observed a residual .modal-bg overlay on initial page load (likely a cookie/consent or marketing modal) that intercepts pointer events on auth-btn and other elements until dismissed. In automated tests I removed it via JS; recommend ensuring the modal is dismissable with a visible close button and does not block the primary CTA area.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for ChatGPT + ChatGPT mini E2E flows (model select → upload → analyze → badge → credits → Copilot)

test_credentials: mario@studio.it / secret123 (not required; anonymous session with 3 credits was sufficient for the test)
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/invoice.png — synthetic Italian invoice image containing FATTURA N. 2026/114, ACME SRL (P.IVA 01234567890), Studio Rossi (P.IVA 09876543210), Imponibile 1.000,00 EUR, IVA 22% 220,00 EUR, TOTALE 1.220,00 EUR, Bonifico 30gg.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ChatGPT & ChatGPT mini live UI flow is confirmed working. The anonymous session has only 3 free credits; a single UI test run consumes them quickly, so for additional runs log in as mario@studio.it/secret123 or register fresh. Note the residual .modal-bg overlay on load — dismiss or remove it before clicking primary buttons.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Initial first-run test script failed because (a) a modal-bg overlay intercepted clicks, and (b) script accidentally clicked the hero CTA ('analizza gratis il tuo primo documento') instead of the actual 'Analizza Documento' button under the upload zone. Fixed by removing modal via JS and using get_by_role('button', name='Analizza Documento'); subsequent runs passed cleanly.
